commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief freed from the Owing barge by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. She serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule Argonia. The Hists along the river are sickening, including Jal-Veesa Hist (dry bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool). The cause is unknown. 2. Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task, in her house in Jal-Veesa (she is the quest marker). 3. I can talk to her, or first talk to Weeltul about sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel. I can fight where needed; I mean to pursue the truth. 4. I do not know why the trees sicken or what Umbriel really did beyond the 4E 48 story. I could find out by asking Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Jal-Veesa sap, drawn before the scar closed. Hists are joined at the root, so drinking it lets me ask where the sickness is. 2. Drink the sap here in front of Vosh-Leera, then tell her everything I see. 3. Drink it now, or refuse/ask Weeltul first. I will drink it. 4. I do not know what the vision will show or what the sap will do to me; I will find out by drinking.

answer 1. I drank the sap and saw a vision: a young grey Hist among pale stilt huts, a woven weir across a creek, and west of the weir a reed hide beside a lone dead tree with clay jars stacked in its shade. This may show where the sickness comes from. 2. Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, in Jal-Veesa. 3. Tell her everything, or hold something back; I will tell all. Afterwards I could investigate the place. 4. I do not know where the weir, hide and dead tree are, or who lives in the hide or what the jars hold. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

answer 1. The vision place is Teel-Fen Weir, a camp of the Sedge-Wardens south of Jal-Veesa down the creek, where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa Hist roots. Jars by the hide suggest someone is keeping sap. Vosh-Leera warns me to be careful at the hide. 2. Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, the tree-minder, on the platform round the tree. 3. Go and talk to Heem-Jasa first, then investigate the hide carefully; I can talk or fight if it comes to that. I want the truth. 4. I do not know who the Sedge-Wardens are, who keeps the sap in the hide, or why. Heem-Jasa may tell me.

answer 1. Someone drained Heem-Jasa young Hist and sealed its scar with grey paste three nights ago. Strangers calling themselves the Unbound, with no tree or kin, keep jars of sap at the reed hide west of the weir. They are likely behind the draining. 2. Take the note from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir. 3. Fight the three Unbound Sap-Takers (my preferred way), shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or sneak round the open west side to the jars. 4. I do not know who the Unbound really are, who they serve, what the grey paste is, or what the note says. The note may tell me.

answer 1. I killed the three Unbound Sap-Takers and took their note. Their master orders jars brought to Karsh-Naal Camp and every scar sealed behind them. So someone is deliberately draining and sealing Hists. 2. Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir; she will ask if her tree will live. 3. Be straight with her (she then teaches alchemy and sells to me) or ease her with a kind word (she will not deal with me after). I will be straight, as I want the truth. Later I could go to Karsh-Naal Camp. 4. I do not know who the master is, where Karsh-Naal Camp is, or whether the tree will live. I may learn from Heem-Jasa and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. First Dream is done. Hists are being drained of sap and sealed by Unbound crews, whose master sends jars to Karsh-Naal Camp. Heem-Jasa now trusts me. 2. Go to Karsh-Naal Camp, the Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. 3. Go there to fight or sneak; or first buy sap, fungus and eggshells and learn alchemy from Heem-Jasa. 4. I do not know who leads the Unbound, why they drain Hists, what the grey paste is, or what Umbriel did.

answer I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who serves the Toh-Reel-Ka. I drank Jal-Veesa sap and saw Teel-Fen Weir. Heem-Jasa, minder of the young Hist there, found its scar sealed with grey paste. I killed the three Unbound Sap-Takers at the reed hide and took their note: their master orders jars brought to Karsh-Naal Camp and every scar sealed. I told Heem-Jasa honestly her tree may die; she thanked me and will teach alchemy and sell sap, fungus and eggshells. I carry the note, 0 gold, a lockpick and the Hist blessing (resist poison). Next: Karsh-Naal Camp, the Naga camp in the marsh east of the weir. Unknown: who the Unbound master is, why Hists are drained, what the grey paste is, and what Umbriel did. Weeltul has untried topics.
